history_basis: broker wall labels; native H1/H4/D1 closed bars; retained actual observed limits
atr_method: Wilder ATR(14), median full and median latest 90 calendar days, recent used for ranking
spreads: same prior native London sample for fair cross-symbol comparison
rank_heuristic: H4 cost <=5%, D1 <=2.5%, max cost 3× swap <=6% ATR D1, 252 D1 bars and feasible lots at 10k for Tier 1; Tier 3 if H4 cost >10%, D1 >5%, or both stops infeasible. Tier 2 otherwise.
